1.body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Junior UX/UI Designer position at Kor.Gy after seeing your opening for team members to build intuitive interfaces for AI-powered solutions and custom software development.

I bring hands-on proficiency in Figma, including components, Auto Layout, and prototyping, alongside a B.Tech in Computer Science that gives me a strong grasp of technical feasibility. At AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and directly fed my findings back into improved user flows and wireframes.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for complex B2B teams, which you can explore in detail within my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a brief look at that project and a quick chat about your upcoming product requirements?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/
